title: A clear expiry date, with applicants steering enforcement
answer: End lifelong disclosure for eligible childhood convictions carrying custody of two years or less. Set the limit at 11 years from conviction, as proposed in s2. Keep serious violent and sexual offences disclosed, and preserve safeguards for child-safety and care work. Let applicants run local advice groups that help challenge expired records on job and college checks. Give these groups power to demand corrections, with checking firms paying correction costs when they get it wrong. Judge success by fewer expired records appearing, quicker corrections, and more applicants reaching work or study. Publish anonymous results each year.
